desc: Weatherby's first new action in over 50 years. The Model 307 was purpose built to accommodate the vast offerings of stocks, triggers, rails, mounts, and bottom metals that exist in the marketplace. The 2-Lug bolt features a convenient "tool-less" takedown for easy disassembly and maintenance. Shooters can expect the same precision craftsmanship that Weatherby has delivered since 1945.
